confidence_explanation: The timeline shows a clear and sustained pattern of an insider threat (user_07) performing unauthorized data collection. The user accessed and downloaded files from nearly every department (Marketing, HR, Finance, DevOps, Engineering, Sales, Legal) which is far outside their baseline of security and logs. The volume and variety of cross-departmental downloads constitute a successful data exfiltration event.

attack_chain.description: User_07 logs in during off-hours (08:04) from their normal IP.
User_07 begins accessing files outside their department, starting with Marketing.
User_07 expands access to the HR department.
User_07 initiates a bulk download of multiple security and log files.
User_07 accesses shared project files (Project Beta).

gaps: Lack of ticket numbers or maintenance window documentation to justify the cross-departmental access.
No information on whether the user's role was recently changed to allow broader access.
narrative: User_07, a security analyst, engaged in a massive unauthorized data collection campaign by accessing and downloading files from almost every department in the organization, including HR, Finance, Engineering, and Legal. This behavior, occurring during off-hours and involving a high volume of cross-departmental downloads, strongly indicates an insider threat and successful data exfiltration.
